CustomField.description: Flow-managed checkbox. True when all Document_Checklist__c records the Case-first engine linked to this Case (Case__c = Case.Id, Case_Creation_Rule__c not null — i.e. Is_Required_For_Case__c docs from Case_Creation_Doc_Requirement__c) have Status = Final, or when none are linked. Maintained by Case_Creation_Trigger_Flow. Status indicator only — since Case creation is Case-first, this no longer gates Case creation, only shows document-collection progress on an already-created Case.
CustomField.label: All Start Docs Final
